resolved_candidate01_findings.resolution: Cylinder distance uses radial and vertical excess. Roof distance uses finite radial/y frustum profile. Full Euler inverse remains applied; broadphase remains AABB.

tower_floor55 uses its cylinder mesh/collider; tower_roof55 uses its tapered mesh/convex collider. Every pooled reuse resets collider scale, assigns default box for other cells, and restores default debris mesh.

review_passes.result: tower_floor55/tower_roof55 have zero jitter, preserving flat initial visual/collision alignment.
Full cell bounds are inserted in every overlapping8m bucket and candidates are deduplicated, so giant columns and long spans are discoverable away from their center.
Merged dirty AABB is only broadphase; separate actual changed-cell regions gate refinement. Distant simultaneous collapses do not refine untouched intermediate sections.
Before disabling a damaged coarse section, all alive intersecting masonry/bridge cells receive exact shapes. The surviving rear skin stays hittable; dead mapped shapes are disabled.
Delayed support kills also invoke sync. Tall masonry adds a support hole near its upper edge and raises support search height; existing local footprint and delays remain.
Existing merlon, courtyard and stair-row colliders are excluded from duplicate exact-shape creation. Full Euler rotations are used for projecting arches.
Existing furnishings and keep-floor coarse collision behavior remains in the prior path. Sync explicitly skips those bodies; nonmasonry blast distance remains center based.
Previously permanent sills, corbels, tower disks and roofs now enter destructible cells and masonry hit shapes.
